hypothesis: If the frozen V11 target path is executed one additional common simulator session later under the already-frozen adverse execution assumptions (1.50% fee + 0.10% slippage), the strategy should remain economically positive and within the frozen drawdown stress bound. The delay changes only execution timing; it must not change the source V11 target path or introduce a new strategy rule.
allowed_changes: execution timing only: each distinct source V11 rebalance event is replayed one common BacktestDailySimulator session later
the formal delayed replay keeps the already-frozen adverse execution assumptions: 1.50% fee and 0.10% slippage
forbidden_changes: any V11 target-path logic or parameter change
any fee or slippage retuning after seeing delay1
using Python to simulate portfolio returns or strategy targets
replacing the same-engine research-provider replay after seeing the formal result
selection_metric: No winner selection. First require the delay=0 same-engine replay control to match the locked G5-001 adverse-cost result within preregistered tolerances, then mechanically evaluate the delay=1 candidate against the frozen G5 gates.
pass_fail_gates: source V11 target fingerprint must equal ba67c8aa24bc7168
delay0 control CAGR must match G5-001 adverse_cost within 0.01 percentage points
delay0 control MDD must match G5-001 adverse_cost within 0.01 percentage points
delay0 control Sharpe must match G5-001 adverse_cost within 0.001
delay0 control trade-record count must equal G5-001 adverse_cost trade-record count
every delay0 schedule row must declare configured_delay_sessions=0 and execution date equal source date
delay1 MDD <= 2.0 * frozen V11 base MDD = 15.378108%
delay1 schedule must contain the same source rebalance-date sequence and count as delay0
every delay1 schedule row must declare configured_delay_sessions=1 and stressed execution date must differ from source date
all two preregistered candidate outputs, portfolio series and schedule mappings must be reported
full G5 PASS requires both the previously locked G5-001 execution-cost component PASS and every gate in this delay trial PASS
follow_up_policy: No additional execution-delay horizon or alternative cost setting may be tried on this historical dataset for V11 after the formal delay1 result is observed. A FAIL is permanent for V11 G5. Fixing a demonstrated implementation bug is allowed only with an INVALID result for this trial and a newly preregistered trial; the failed/invalid evidence must remain in the ledger.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_v11_execution_delay_stress.py -> tools/v11_execution_delay_stress.swiftpart -> BacktestEngine.runAdvancedRotationStrategyWithTrace (source V11) + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace (fixed target replay) -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: portfolio value series for delay0 and delay1
source-to-execution schedule CSV for delay0 and delay1 with configured_delay_sessions
run authorization receipt and exact Git execution commit
